commons.title: Chulym region.png
commons.description:
Extent of the Chulym Tatar ("Meletsk Tatar") settlement area
in the 16th century (yellow, yellow-green and yellow-red striped) according to Brockhaus and Efron Encyclopedic Dictionary (1897) and Ethnolinguistic map of Siberia, based on the 1600 tsarist yasak
in the 19th century (yellow and yellow-red striped) according to Valeriya Lemskaya (Word Order Variation in Chulym Turkic of Siberia, 2022)
in the 20th century (yellow-red-striped and red dots) according to J.W. Bromlej (народы мира – историко-этнографический справочник, 1988)
commons.editorial_reason: Settlement-area map with modern graphic styling; it does not show Chulym cultural material.
